::: {.entry-meta}
[decision]{.chip .decision} Entry 53 · milestone M4
:::

The owner chose to retain the current nonnegative heat-flux approximation,
physical contract and raw guard while investigating the signed TGLF flux. The
conversion review establishes an inferred negative sign without a denominator
sign reversal ([the final electron heat flux is inferred as -0.001689376033 gB; all 9 negative channel records at 8 accepted states have outward-decreasing temperature and no denominator-epsilon sign reversal, with maximum epsilon ratio 1.03e-11; all negative magnitudes are below 1 gB]{.claim}[C-195](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-195){.cid .st-measured}), but does not identify the physical or
numerical origin. The decision adopts no projected reference or signed-heat
closure. Formal candidate acceptance remains not evaluable and [K-030](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/ceilings.qmd#k-030) stays open.

| decision | result |
|---|---|
| reference direction | retain the current contract while investigating |
| original toolkit code/documentation | MIT licence selected |
| new solver execution | separate concrete review required |

The repository now carries the MIT licence text, attributed to Vignesh Gopakumar,
and its package metadata reads that file. Local source and wheel builds contain
the licence and declare it in their metadata. The wheel retains the existing
EPEDNN licence and notice unchanged. Third-party licences, experimental-data
restrictions and repository privacy still apply.

No runtime code, tests or models changed. Existing test statistics remain retained
execution evidence ([33 focused checks pass in each mode, including 14 new sign/units/history tests; all 80 native heat-converter round trips meet the mixed 1e-12 parity criterion (maximum absolute difference 8.88e-16 m²/s), 32 numerical source files match the diagnostic bindings, and all 78 source modules pass typing]{.claim}[C-196](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-196){.cid .st-tested} supplies the prior focused checks); no
fresh physics or full-suite run is claimed.

**What's next.** Prepare the richer diagnostic output route, validation and
allocation before requesting compute review. No solver, training, submission,
synchronization or replacement occurred.
